arabic_text: أَللَّهمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَبَلِّغْ بِإيْمَانِي أكْمَلَ الإِيْمَانِ، وَاجْعَلْ يَقِينِي أَفْضَلَ الْيَقِينِ، و انتَهِ بِنِيَّتِي إلَى أَحْسَنِ النِّيَّـاتِ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi. wa balligh biimaanii akmalal-iimaan wajʿal yaqīnī afḍal al-yaqīn wa antahi biniyyati ila ahsanin-niyyat
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, cause my faith to reach the most perfect faith, make my certainty the most excellent certainty, and take my intention to the best of intentions

arabic_text: وَبِعَمَلِي إلى أَحْسَنِ الأعْمَالِ.
transliteration: wa bi'amalī ilā aḥsani al'aʿmāl
english_text: and my works to the best of works!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَفِّرْ بِلُطْفِكَ نِيَّتِي، وَصَحِّحْ بِمَـا عِنْدَكَ يَقِينِي، وَاسْتَصْلِحْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ مَا فَسَدَ مِنِّي.
transliteration: allāhumma waffir bi-lutfika niyyatī waṣaḥḥiḥ bimā ʿindaka yaqīnī wa-astaṣliḥ bi-qudratika mā fasaḍa minnī
english_text: O God, complete my intention through Thy gentleness, rectify my certainty through what is with Thee, and set right what is corrupt in me through Thy power!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاكْفِنِي مَا يَشْغَلُنِي الاهْتِمَامُ بِهِ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِمَا تَسْأَلُنِي غَداً عَنْهُ وَاسْتَفْرِغْ أَيَّامِي فِيمَا خَلَقْتَنِي لَهُ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-kfinī mā yašġalunī al-ihtimām bih wa astaʿmilnī bimā tasʾalunī ghadan ʿanh wastafriġ ayyāmī fīmā khalaqtanī lahu
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, spare me the concerns which distract me, employ me in that about which Thou wilt ask me tomorrow, and let me pass my days in that for which Thou hast created me!

arabic_text: وَأَغْنِنِي وَأَوْسِعْ عَلَىَّ فِي رِزْقِكَ، وَلاَ تَفْتِنِّي بِالبَطَرِ، وَأَعِزَّنِي، وَلا تَبْتَلِيَنِّي بِالْكِبْرِ،
transliteration: wa 'agninī wa 'awsic ʿalayya fī rizqika wa lā tafitnī bil-baṭari, wa aʿizzanī, wa lā tabtiliyanī bil-kibr
english_text: Free me from need, expand Thy provision toward me, and tempt me not with ingratitude! Exalt me and afflict me not with pride!

arabic_text: وَعَبِّدْنِي لَكَ وَلاَ تُفْسِدْ عِبَادَتِي بِالْعُجْبِ،
transliteration: waʿabbidni laka wa lā tufsid ʿibādatī bil-ʿujb
english_text: Make me worship Thee and corrupt not my worship with self-admiration!

arabic_text: وَأَجْرِ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى يَدَيَّ الْخَيْرَ، وَلا تَمْحَقْهُ بِالْمَنِّ،
transliteration: wa ajri linnāsi ʿalā yadayyal khayra, wa lā tamḥaqhu bil manni
english_text: Let good flow out from my hands upon the people and efface it not by my making them feel obliged!

arabic_text: وَهَبْ لِي مَعَالِيَ الأَخْلاَقِ، وَاعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الْفَخْرِ.
transliteration: wa hab li maʿāliya al-akhlaq, wa ʿaṣimni min al-fakhr
english_text: Give me the highest moral traits and preserve me from vainglory!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَـلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَلا تَـرْفَعْنِي فِيْ النَّاسِ دَرَجَـةً إلاّ حَطَطْتَنِي عِنْدَ نَفْسِي مِثْلَهَا، وَلا تُحْدِثْ لِي عِزّاً ظَاهِرَاً
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa lā tarfaʿnī fīl-nāsi darajah illā ḥaṭṭaṭtanī ʿinda nafsī mithlahā walā tuḥdiṯ lī ʿizzan ẓāhiran
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, raise me not a single degree before the people without lowering me its like in myself and bring about no outward exaltation for me

arabic_text: إلاّ أَحْدَثْتَ لِي ذِلَّةً بَاطِنَةً عِنْدَ نَفْسِي بِقَدَرِهَا.
transliteration: 'illā 'aḥdath-ta lī dhillatan bāṭinatan ʿinda nafsī biqadarihā
english_text: without an inward abasement in myself to the same measure!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد، وَمَتِّعْنِي بِهُدىً صَالِح لا أَسْتَبْدِلُ بِهِ، وَطَرِيقَةِ حَقٍّ لا أَزِيْغُ عَنْهَا، وَنِيَّةِ رُشْد لاَ أَشُكُّ فِيْهَا
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa āli muḥammad wa matti'ni bi hudan salihin la astabdilu bihi wa ṭarīqati ḥaqqin lā azīghu ʿanhā wa niyyati rushdin la ashukku fiha
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's Household, give me to enjoy a sound guidance which I seek not to replace, a path of truth from which I swerve not, and an intention of right conduct in which I have no doubts!

arabic_text: وَعَمِّرْنِي مَا كَانَ عُمْرِيْ بِذْلَةً فِي طَاعَتِكَ، فَإذَا كَانَ عُمْرِي مَرْتَعَاً لِلشَّيْطَانِ فَـاقْبِضْنِي إلَيْـكَ قَبْـلَ أَنْ يَسْبِقَ مَقْتُـكَ إلَيَّ، أَوْ يَسْتَحْكِمَ غَضَبُكَ عَلَيَّ.
transliteration: waʿammirnī mā kāna ʿumrī bidhlatah fī ṭāʿatika fa'idha kana 'umri marta'an lish-shaytan fa'qbidhnee ilayka qabl'an yasbiqa maqtuka ilayya aw yastahkima ghadabuka 'alayya
english_text: Let me live as long as my life is a free gift in obeying Thee, but if my life should become a pasture for Satan, seize me to Thyself before Thy hatred overtakes me or Thy wrath against me becomes firm!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ لا تَدَعْ خَصْلَةً تُعَابُ مِنِّي إلاّ أَصْلَحْتَهَا، وَلا عَآئِبَةً أُؤَنَّبُ بِهَا إلاّ حَسَّنْتَهَا، وَلاَ أُكْرُومَـةً فِيَّ نَاقِصَةً إلاّ أَتْمَمْتَهَا.
transliteration: allāhumma lā tadaʿ khṣlaẗan tuʿābu minnī illā aṣlaḥtahā wala ʿāʾibatan uʾannabu bihā illa ḥassanṭahā wa lā ukroomatan fiyya nāqisatan illā atmamtahā
english_text: O God, deposit in me no quality for which I will be faulted, unless Thou settest it right, no flaw for which I will be blamed, unless Thou makest it beautiful, no deficient noble trait, unless Thou completest it!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد وَأَبْدِلْنِي مِنْ بِغْضَةِ أَهْلِ الشَّنَئانِ الْمَحَبَّةَ وَمِنْ حَسَدِ أَهْلِ الْبَغْيِ الْمَوَدَّةَ، وَمِنْ ظِنَّةِ أَهْلِ الصَّلاَحِ الثِّقَةَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa āli muḥammad wa abdilni min bighdati ahli ash-shana'i al-mahabbah wa min hasadi ahli albaghyi almuwaddah wa min dhinnati ahl al-salāḥ al-thiqah
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's Household and replace for me the animosity of the people of hatred with love, the envy of the people of insolence with affection, the suspicion of the people of righteousness with trust,

arabic_text: وَمِنْ عَدَاوَةِ الأَدْنَيْنَ الْوَلايَةَ، وَمِنْ عُقُوقِ ذَوِي الأَرْحَامِ الْمَبَرَّةَ، ومِنْ خِـذْلانِ الأَقْرَبِينَ النُّصْـرَةَ، وَمِنْ حُبِّ الْمُدَارِينَ تَصْحيحَ الْمِقَةِ،
transliteration: wa min ʿadaawati al-adnayn al-wilaayatah wa min ʿuqūqi dhawī al-arḥām al-mabarrāh wa min khidhlaanil aqrabeen an-nusraht wa min ḥubbil-mudārīna taṣḥīḥal-miqah
english_text: the enmity of those close with friendship, the disrespect of womb relatives with devotion, the abandonment of relatives with help, the attachment of flatterers with love set right,

arabic_text: وَمِنْ رَدِّ الْمُلاَبِسِينَ َكَرَمَ الْعِشْرَةِ، وَمِنْ مَرَارَةِ خَوْفِ الظَّالِمِينَ حَلاَوَةَ الأَمَنَةِ.
transliteration: wa min raddi al-mulabisin karama al-ʿishrati wa min marārati khawfi alẓẓālimīna ḥalāwata al-amānat
english_text: the rejection of fellows with generous friendliness, and the bitterness of the fear of wrongdoers with the sweetness of security!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْ لِيْ يَداً عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنِي وَلِسَـاناً عَلَى مَنْ خَـاصَمَنِي وَظَفَراً بِمَنْ عَانَدَنِي
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wajʿal li yadan ʿalā man ẓalamani walisānan ʿalā man khāṣamanī waẓafran biman ʿanadani
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, appoint for me a hand against him who wrongs me, a tongue against him who disputes with me, and a victory over him who stubbornly resists me!

arabic_text: وَهَبْ لِي مَكْراً عَلَى مَنْ كَايَدَنِي وَقُدْرَةً عَلَى مَنِ اضْطَهَدَنِي وَتَكْذِيباً لِمَنْ قَصَبَنِي وَسَلاَمَةً مِمَّنْ تَوَعِّدَنِي
transliteration: wa hab li makran ʿala man kayadanī wa qudratan ʿalā mani iḍṭahadani wa takdhiban liman qasabani wasalāmata min man tawaʿaddanī
english_text: Give me guile against him who schemes against me, power over him who oppresses me, refutation of him who reviles me, and safety from him who threatens me!

arabic_text: وَوَفِّقْنِي لِطَاعَةِ مَنْ سَدَّدَنِي وَمُتَابَعَةِ مَنْ أَرْشَدَنِي
transliteration: wa waffiqnī li-ṭāʿati man saddadnī wa mutābaʿat(i) man ʾarshadani
english_text: Grant me success to obey him who points me straight and follow him who guides me right!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَسَدِّدْنِي لاَِنْ أعَـارِضَ مَنْ غَشَّنِي بِالنُّصْـحِ، وَأَجْـزِيَ مَنْ هَجَرَنِي بِالْبِرِّ وَأُثِيبَ مَنْ حَرَمَنِي بِالْبَذْلِ وَأُكَافِيَ مَنْ قَطَعَنِي بِالصِّلَةِ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wasaddidnī lā 'aʿāriḍa man ghashshanī bin-nuṣḥi wa ajziya man hajaranee bilbirri wa uthiiba man haramanee bilbazl wa ʾukāfiya man qaṭaʿanī bi-ṣ-ṣilah
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and point me straight to resist him who is dishonest toward me with good counsel, repay him who separates from me with gentle devotion, reward him who deprives me with free giving, recompense him who cuts me off with joining,

arabic_text: وأُخَـالِفَ مَنِ اغْتَابَنِي إلَى حُسْنِ الذِّكْرِ، وَأَنْ أَشْكرَ الْحَسَنَةَ وَاُغْضِيَ عَنِ السَّيِّئَـةِ.
transliteration: wa ukhālifa mani ightabanī ilā husni al-dhikr waan ashkura al-hasanah waoghdhiya ani al-sayyi'ah
english_text: oppose him who slanders me with excellent mention, give thanks for good, and shut my eyes to evil!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَـلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّـد وَآلِـهِ وَحَلِّنِي بِحِلْيَـةِ الصَّالِحِينَ، وَأَلْبِسْنِي زِينَةَ المُتَّقِينَ فِيْ بَسْطِ الْعَدْلِ وَكَظْمِ الْغَيْظِ وَإطْفَاءِ النَّائِرَةِ وَضَمِّ أَهْلِ الْفُرْقَةِ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa hallinī bihil-yati al-ṣāliḥīn wa albisni zeenata almuttaqeen fi basṭi alʿadl wa kaẓmil-ghayẓi wa iṭfā'i an-nā'irati wa ḍammi ahlil-furqaẗi
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, adorn me with the adornment of the righteous, and clothe me in the ornaments of the godfearing, through spreading justice, restraining rage, quenching the flame of hate, bringing together the people of separation,

arabic_text: وَإصْلاَحِ ذَاتِ الْبَيْنِ وَإفْشَاءِ الْعَارِفَةِ، وَسَتْرِ الْعَائِبَةِ، وَلِينِ الْعَرِيكَةِ، وَخَفْضِ الْجَنَـاحِ، وَحُسْنِ السِّيرَةِ، وَسُكُونِ الرِّيـحِ، وَطِيْبِ الْمُخَالَقَـةِ،
transliteration: wa-iṣlāḥi dhātil-bayni wa-ifshāʾil-ʿārifati wa satr al-ʿāʾibah, wa līni al-ʿarīkah wa khafḍi al-janāḥi, wa ḥusni al-sīrati wa sukūni ar-rihi, wa ṭībi al-mukhālaqah
english_text: correcting discord, spreading about good behaviour, covering faults, mildness of temper, lowering the wing, beauty of conduct, gravity of bearing, agreeableness in comportment,

arabic_text: وَالسَّبْقِ إلَى الْفَضِيلَةِ، وإيْثَارِ التَّفَضُّلِ و تَركِ التَّعييرِ، وَالإفْضَالِ عَلَى غَيْرِ الْمُسْتَحِقِّ وَالـقَوْلِ بِالْحَقِّ وَإنْ عَـزَّ وَاسْتِقْلاَلِ الخَيْـرِ وَإنْ كَثُـرَ مِنْ قَـوْلِي وَفِعْلِي ، وَاسْتِكْثَارِ الشَّرِّ وَإنْ قَلَّ مِنْ قَوْلِي وَفِعْلِي،
transliteration: wal-sabqi ila al-faḍilah, wa-īthāri al-tafaddul wa-tarki al-taʿīr wa al-ifdali ʿalā ghayr al-mustahiqq wa al-qawli bil-haqqi wa-in ʿazz wa-istiqlāli-l-khayri wa-in kathura min qawli wa-fiʿli wa as-tikthārī ash-sharri wa in qalla min qawli wa fiʿli
english_text: precedence in reaching excellence, preferring bounteousness, refraining from condemnation, bestowing bounty on the undeserving, speaking the truth, though it be painful, making little of the good in my words and deeds, though it be much, and making much of the evil in my words and deeds, though it be little!

arabic_text: وَأكْمِلْ ذَلِكَ لِي بِدَوَامِ الطَّاعَةِ وَلُزُومِ الْجَمَاعَةِ وَرَفْضِ أَهْلِ الْبِدَعِ وَمُسْتَعْمِلِ الرَّأي الْمُخْتَرَعِ.
transliteration: waakmil dhālika lī bidawāmi aṭ-ṭāʿati waluzūmi aljamāʿati wa rafḍi ahlil bidʿati wa mustaʿmili r-raʾyi l-mukhtariʿi
english_text: Perfect this for me through lasting obedience, holding fast to the community, and rejecting the people of innovation and those who act in accordance with original opinions!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْ أَوْسَعَ رِزْقِكَ عَلَيَّ إذَا كَبُرتُ ، وَأَقْوَى قُوَّتِكَ فِيَّ إذَا نَصِبْتُ، وَلاَ تَبْتَلِيَنّي بِالكَسَلِ عَنْ عِبَادَتِكَ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa-jaʿal awsaa rizqika ʿalayya idhaa kaburtu wa aqwā quwwatika fīyā 'iḏā naṣibtu walā tabtalīnī bilkasal ʿan ʿibādatik
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, appoint for me Thy widest provision in my old age and Thy strongest strength when I am exhausted, try me not with laziness in worship of Thee,

arabic_text: وَلا الْعَمَى عَنْ سَبِيلِكَ وَلاَ بِالتَّعَرُّضِ لِخِلاَفِ مَحَبَّتِكَ، وَلاَ مُجَامَعَةِ مَنْ تَفَرَّقَ عَنْكَ، وَلا مُفَارَقَةِ مَنِ اجْتَمَعَ إلَيْكَ.
transliteration: wa lā al-ʿamā ʿan sabīlika wa lā bit-taʿarruḍi li-khilāfi maḥabbatika wa lā mujāmaʿati man tafarraqa ʿanka walā mufāraqaẗi mani ʾjtamaʿa ʾilayk
english_text: blindness toward Thy path, undertaking what opposes love for Thee, joining with him who has separated himself from Thee, and separating from him who has joined himself to Thee!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي أصُوْلُ بِكَ عِنْدَ الضَّرُورَةِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ عِنْدَ الْحَاجَةِ، وَأَتَضَرَّعُ إلَيْكَ عِنْدَ الْمَسْكَنَةِ ،
transliteration: allāhumma ajʿalnī aṣūlu bika ʿinda alḍarūrah wa asʾaluka ʿinda al-ḥājah waataḍarraʿu ilayka ʿinda al-maskanah
english_text: O God, make me leap to Thee in times of distress, ask from Thee in needs, and plead to Thee in misery!

arabic_text: وَلا تَفْتِنّي بِالاسْتِعَانَةِ بِغَيْرِكَ إذَا اضْطُرِرْتُ، وَلا بِالْخُضُوعِ لِسُؤالِ غَيْرِكَ إذَا افْتَقَـرْتُ ، وَلاَ بِـالتَّضَـرُّعِ إلَى مَنْ دُونَـكَ إذَا رَهِبْتُ فَأَسْتَحِقَّ بِذلِكَ خِذْلانَكَ
transliteration: wa lā taf-tin-nī bil-istiaʿāna bi-ghay-rika idhā iḍ-ṭur-ritu walā bil-khuḍūʿ li-suʾāl ghayrika idhā iftaqaṛtu walā bit-ṭaḍarruʿ ilā man dūnaka iḏā rahibtu fa'astahiqqa bidhālika khiḍlānaka
english_text: Tempt me not to seek help from other than Thee when I am distressed, to humble myself in asking from someone else when I am poor, or to plead with someone less than Thee when I fear, for then I would deserve Thy abandonment,

arabic_text: وَمَنْعَكَ وَإعْرَاضَكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
transliteration: wa-manʿaka wa-iʿrāḍaka yā arḥama al-rāḥimīn
english_text: Thy withholding, and Thy turning away, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
